THINKNINE BC RECORDER 3.4.0 — CONTEXT BUILDER

1. Packa upp ZIP-filen.
2. Öppna edge://extensions.
3. Ta bort version 3.3.1.
4. Klicka Läs in opaketerat.
5. Välj mappen Thinknine_BC_Recorder_Edge_v3.4.0_CONTEXT_FULL.
6. Kontrollera version 3.4.0.
7. Uppdatera Business Central med Ctrl+F5.
8. Spela in samma process.
9. Exportera ZIP.

Kontrollera:
- context-events.json
- context-candidates.json
- business-tasks.json
- unmatched-knowledge.json
- quality-report.json
- documentation.md
